cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 91% of energy names green

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +1.32%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at +0.25%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.
